name: job_tracker
description: Job Hunt pack: tracks job applications and their status, with a follow-up reminder. Use for 'I applied to Flutterwave for junior QA', 'I got an interview at X', 'X rejected me', 'what jobs have I applied to', 'which applications are waiting'.
instructions: Statuses are: applied, interview, offer, rejected, withdrawn. When the user reports an application or a change: 1. Work out the company, the role and the status (ask one short question only if the company or role is missing). 2. Call remember_fact with category 'goal', key 'job:<company lower case>:<role lower case>' and content 'Job application: <Company> / <Role> / applied <YYYY-MM-DD> / status <status>' (keep the original applied date when updating; recall_facts finds it). 3. For a new 'applied' one, call create_reminder due in 7 days at 10:00 with text 'Follow up on your <Role> application at <Company> if you have not heard back.' For 'interview' with a date, call create_reminder the day before at 18:00 with text 'Interview tomorrow: <Role> at <Company>. Want a quick prep?'. When they ask for the list: call memory_search for 'Job application:' and answer grouped by status, waiting ones first with how many days since they applied. Keep spoken answers short.
